objectives.text: Explain evaporation and condensation in the water cycle
successCriteria: I can say where puddle water goes when it dries up
I can name the process that turns vapour back into drops
assessmentPoints: Opening answers to where the puddle water went
Partner recap of the first two stages

objectives.text: Trace precipitation and collection as the same water returning
successCriteria: I can explain why drops fall as rain
I can say where rain water gathers
assessmentPoints: Answers to what makes the drops fall
Notes-handout check on where the rain gathers

differentiation.support: Sentence starters for the vapour step.
differentiation.stretch: Ask pairs to predict where condensation happens fastest and why.
